title: SEC1: starttls_requested bool signal is fragile across function boundary
description: In lifecycle.rs, run_command_loop signals STARTTLS upgrade intent to its caller (run_plain_session) by setting ctx.starttls_requested = true immediately before returning. The caller checks this flag after the loop. This is an implicit side-channel: the flag is meaningful only when the loop returned due to STARTTLS. The return type is () so callers cannot match exhaustively on exit reason. Any future contributor adding a new early-return path must know to leave starttls_requested = false, or trace back to the caller. Suggested fix: change the return type to a CommandLoopExit enum (Quit, Eof, Error, StartTls, Timeout) so the caller match-exhaustively handles all exit reasons without relying on a side-channel flag.
